scope: Strict human/human-derived observation-level model-resource screen of every Dryad model-use inventory row.

criteria.include: Human participant/patient data, human-derived biological material, or demonstrably human-derived annotation/synthetic data that exposes structured observation-level inputs, labels, annotations, signals, or measurements sufficient to define an ML task.
criteria.exclude: Nonhuman-only resources; article result tables, aggregate summaries, literature/meta-analysis outputs, code-only/config-only deposits, and data without demonstrated observation-level ML structure.
criteria.relationship_handling: Retain meaningful derived annotation layers as relationships/alternate sources when they should not be independent canonical records.
